title: ReflectPO: Reflection-Guided Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.30933v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With external tools, large language models (LLMs) can tackle complex tasks through sustained environmental interaction. LLM-based agents are therefore increasingly used to tackle complex long-horizon tasks in real-world environments. However, these tasks involve sequential, interdependent decisions and changes in environmental states. Early execution errors affect subsequent interaction histories and environmental states, and their effects accumulate along the decision chain. To address this challenge, we propose Reflection-Guided Policy Optimization (ReflectPO), a reinforcement learning framework for autonomous error recovery in long-horizon tasks. ReflectPO comprises two core components. The first is Reflection-Guided Sampling. We use branch differences and repeated visits in interaction trajectories to construct hints for error recovery. translated_title: ReflectPO：面向长程大语言模型智能体的反思引导策略优化
translated_abstract: 借助外部工具，大语言模型（LLM）能够通过与环境的持续交互来解决复杂任务。因此，基于LLM的智能体正被越来越多地用于处理真实世界环境中的复杂长程任务。然而，这些任务涉及顺序性的、相互依赖的决策以及环境状态的变化。早期的执行错误会影响后续的交互历史和环境状态，并且其影响会沿着决策链不断累积。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了反思引导策略优化（ReflectPO），这是一个面向长程任务中自主错误恢复的强化学习框架。ReflectPO包含两个核心组件。第一个是反思引导采样，我们利用交互轨迹中的分支差异和重复访问来构建错误恢复的提示。第二个是树结构信用分配，我们将采样得到的轨迹组织成树形结构……
tldr: ReflectPO是一个强化学习框架，通过反思引导采样和树结构信用分配两大核心组件，实现长程任务中大语言模型智能体的自主错误恢复。
en_tdlr: ReflectPO is a reinforcement learning framework that enables autonomous error recovery for long-horizon LLM agents through two core components: reflection-guided sampling and tree-structured credit assignment.
